tutorial.welcomeBody: We can show you how rider transfers, free agents, scouting, contract negotiations, and staff hiring work.
tutorial.transferListBody:
This is the Transfers page.

In the Riders section, the Transfer List shows riders currently listed by other teams, including AI teams.

Before you scout a rider, some information may be hidden or less precise. Scouting gives you better information about the rider’s skills and potential.

Each transfer listing shows how long the offer is valid and the starting price for negotiations. If you click Make Offer, you can offer money to the selling team. If the team accepts, you then negotiate the rider contract.
tutorial.freeAgentsBody:
Free Agents are riders without a team.

The big difference is that there is no selling team between you and the rider. If you want a free agent, you go directly into contract negotiation.

You can negotiate salary, contract duration, and agent fee. The offer outlook helps you understand whether your offer looks strong, risky, or unlikely to succeed.
tutorial.staffBody:
The Staff tab shows available free-agent staff members.

Here you can review staff skills, role, salary, specialization, and availability. Only free-agent staff can be hired.

Staff limits are important. If your club has already reached the maximum number for a staff role, you cannot hire another staff member for that role until you increase the limit, usually through infrastructure upgrades.

After Transfers, the next recommended page is Finance.
